to: you, or each member of the party. The member that leaves or that the leader kicks gets only an empty object

variants.name: State
variants.when: `send_party_update`: every 60 s, and after a member dies, respawns or gets a `revival`. Also the reply to a `party` `kick` of a name that is not in the party.

variants.name: Joined
variants.when: A `party` `accept` or `raccept` added a member. Each member gets it, the new member too.

variants.name: Left
variants.when: A member left the party, the leader kicked a member, or a member disconnected. Each other member gets it. With fewer than 2 members left, `list` is `false` and `party` is `{}`: the party is gone.

variants.name: None
variants.when: You are not in a party now: you left, the leader kicked you, or you joined another party.

PartyUpdateState.summary: The members of the party and their info.

fields.name: list
fields.description: The names of the members in order. The first name is the leader. The name of the leader is also the name of the party.

fields.name: party
fields.description: The info of each member, keyed by name. A member that is not on this server now is not in it.

PartyUpdateJoined.summary: A text that a member joined, with the new members and their info.

fields.name: phrase
fields.description: `server.party.joined_with_invite` when a member that is not the leader sent the invite (`accept`). After `accept`, `phrase_args` has `player` (the new member) and `inviter`, with either phrase; after `raccept`, it has only `player` and the phrase is `server.party.joined`.

fields.name: list
fields.description: The names of the members in order. The first name is the leader.

fields.name: party
fields.description: The info of each member, keyed by name.

PartyUpdateLeft.summary: A text that a member left, with the members that stay.

fields.name: leave
fields.description: Always 1. It marks a member that left.

fields.name: list
fields.description: The members that stay, in order. `false` when fewer than 2 members stay.

fields.name: party
fields.description: The info of each member that stays. `{}` when fewer than 2 members stay.

confirm.note: `list` is `newparty.length >= 2 && newparty`, so `false` for a party that is gone

PartyUpdateNone.summary: An empty object: you are not in a party now.

senders.what: `send_party_update`: the state to each member. A member that is not on this server leaves the party first.
The party loop: `send_party_update` for each party, every 60 s.
The `party` handler, `accept` and `raccept`: Joined to the party (`party_emit`).
`leave_party`: Left to each other member. It runs for `party` `leave`, `kick`, `accept`, `raccept`, and on `disconnect`.
The `party` handler: None to you on `accept` or `raccept` when you leave your old party, on `leave`, and to the kicked member.
The `party` handler, `kick` of a name that is not in the party: State to you.
